text:
Dana W: FYI all-hands next Weds 9:30am PT. short agenda: 1) Exec update (10m) 2) Ops: Dedicated launch callouts + migration checklist (12m) 3) Policy: hosted logs retention & default PII scrub (10m) 4) Live Q&A and one-page takeaways. please drop Qs here.
Priya K: we'll present the policy changes — moving hosted logs to 90-day rolling retention and enabling a default PII redaction pipeline for inbound payloads. demo snippet and rollback plan included.
Marco H: request: can we get a one-line "impact summary" we can forward to customers?
Priya K: yes. we'll craft a customer-facing blurb and the internal tech checklist.
Ivy S: accessibility: enable live captions and post transcript. also request speaker notes for recording.
Eli P: ops ask: for Dedicated migrations, can we outline blackout windows and a dry-run plan?
Dana W: good call. slide will include: dry-run checklist, expected downtime (none for most customers), backfill steps, and contact path for urgent rollback.
Marco H: can the doc include the console toggle screenshot? helps support teams.
Eli P: +1, and add exact API header change example for teams consuming raw logs: ```
X-Redwood-PII-Scrub: true
```
Priya K: added. we'll also show the config snippet: ```json
{"pii_scrub": {"default": true, "rules": ["email","phone"], "mask": "[REDACTED]"}}
```
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — All-Hands Wed 9:30am PT — 24h and 15m reminders.
RecordingBot: recording + transcript will be posted to internal drive within 1 hour after meeting. captions enabled.
Marco H: one more Q for Q&A: will retention policy affect analytics exports / audit logs?
Priya K: short answer: analytics exports will keep aggregated metrics unaffected; raw audit exports follow the retention window unless customer requests an extended archive (billable option). we'll cover that in the Q&A.
Ivy S: can we include a two-bullet "what engineers should do" on the final slide? makes rollouts easier.
Dana W: yes — "update ingestion clients to accept PII-scrub header" and "verify console toggle for Dedicated if you manage tenant configs."
Marco H: thanks. I'll drop a couple more Qs here later.
Dana W: thanks all. drop any other items in this thread and we'll triage into the live Q&A. see you Weds. :rocket:
